data.title: What's Going On With Robinhood Stock Tuesday?
data.description: Shares of Robinhood Markets Inc (NASDAQ: HOOD) are trading lower Tuesday morning, pulling back despite strong momentum driven by expanding prediction market deals and high anticipation ahead of a crucial Senate vote on digital asset legislation.
